answer: Each identity carries one challenge chain: each epoch's seed hashes from the prior answer, so each link rests on a stone ledge its own key extends. Auditors replay the chain at a verification oasis; a rented head or forked link breaks the hash, and the ripple revokes the whole chain. Forging 1,000 chains needs 1,000 fresh keys at 50 credits each: 50,000 credits against at most 40,000 in rewards. An honest agent pays 50 once, keeps its chain.
